best.plan_strategy: Reclaim the best measured ranking generator (xgboost, iteration 2's exact hyperparameters and scale_pos_weight 5.07, impute=none/scale=false so the trees split on NaN natively) and change exactly one thing: preprocessing gains missing_count=true. This is the run's first preprocessing-only transition, so the paired Δ against iteration 2 (balanced_accuracy 0.7585, roc_auc 0.8572, balanced_accuracy_at_best_cut 0.7851) is attributable to that single aggregate column and nothing else. The column is the one thing a NaN-splitting tree cannot already express — its splits are per column, while missing_count aggregates across the 60 partially-missing columns (worst 0.785), so it stands in for how much of a respondent's questionnaire was completed, which in this file plausibly tracks wave/session rather than a single field. Read balanced_accuracy_at_best_cut on the resulting row: if it stays inside 0.7851~0.7922 the ranking ceiling is confirmed and 0.8882 is unreachable on these columns, and the last iteration should be spent only on the operating point of this same ranking (cut_headroom on iteration 2 was 0.0266, so at most that much is buyable there).

critic.evidence: balanced_accuracy 0.7248 (95% CI 0.6969~0.7527) against the bar 0.8882 — a shortfall of 0.1634. Training is saturated: train_balanced_accuracy/train_f1/train_accuracy all 1.0 with train_val_gap 0.2752, i.e. 400 iterations at lr 0.06 with 31 leaves and only l2=1.0 fully memorised the 5,026 rows. The operating point is nearly spent: recall 0.5254 vs specificity 0.9243 gives cut_headroom 0.0674, only 41% of the 0.1634 still needed, so at most 0.0674 is buyable by any weight/threshold move and the other 0.0960 has to come from the ranking (roc_auc 0.8598, pr_auc 0.6049, balanced_accuracy_at_best_cut 0.7922 — note this cut is a diagnostic, not a score reached). No hyperparameters were dropped (dropped_hyperparams empty), and cost was trivial (train_time 11.58 s), so there is room to spend iterations. Only one family has been tried (hist_gbdt, 1 attempt), so a family plateau is not yet demonstrated; the unremarkable-settings case is also excluded by the 0.2752 gap with a perfect training fit.
critic.direction: Stay in hist_gbdt but cut the capacity hard — the model memorised the training rows (train_balanced_accuracy 1.0, gap 0.2752) so regularising should lift the ranking (roc_auc/balanced_accuracy_at_best_cut), which is where 59% of the remaining distance sits; keep preprocessing and class_weight='balanced' unchanged so the next row is attributable to capacity alone.

critic.evidence: balanced_accuracy 0.7585 (95% CI 0.7301~0.7841) against the bar 0.8882 — shortfall 0.1297. The paired Δ vs iteration 1 is +0.0337 (95% CI +0.0140~+0.0549, P(better) 1.000), so the regularisation did resolve as a real gain, and train_val_gap fell 0.2752 → 0.1776 with train_balanced_accuracy 1.0 → 0.9361: the overfitting prescription worked and is now largely spent. But the gain was almost entirely operating point, not ranking: roc_auc went 0.8598 → 0.8572, pr_auc 0.6049 → 0.5787, and balanced_accuracy_at_best_cut 0.7922 → 0.7851 — i.e. the ranking did not improve at all, the cut simply moved (recall 0.5254 → 0.6449, specificity 0.9243 → 0.8721) and cut_headroom collapsed 0.0674 → 0.0266. Those two numbers are decisive: cut_headroom 0.0266 is 20% of the 0.1297 still needed, so 80% sits in the ranking; and the two families tried span only 0.7851~0.7922 of best_cut (width 0.0071) while the distance from the best cut to the bar is 0.0960 — 14× that span (KS 0.5844 vs required 0.7764). recall 0.6449 is still below specificity 0.8721, so the residual weight move is worth at most ~0.0266 and cannot be repeated for more. No hyperparameters were dropped, early stopping fired at iter 595/800, and cost is trivial (6.5 s of 600 s), so the constraint is not budget — it is that no point in gbdt hyperparameter space, and no threshold, reaches a bar sitting above the ranking ceiling of every ranking measured so far.
critic.direction: Stop spending iterations inside gbdt on capacity/operating-point tweaks — with cut_headroom 0.0266 against 0.1297 still needed and both gbdt rankings pinned at best_cut 0.7851~0.7922 (KS 0.5844 vs the required 0.7764), the only lever with any chance is more information in the columns plus a genuinely different ranking generator, so run one attempt that adds missing_count as a single extra column on top of a NaN-splitting gbdt with capacity between iterations 1 and 2, and if that leaves best_cut inside 0.7851~0.7922 the run has demonstrated the bar is unreachable on these features.
